title: FinGrAct: A Framework for FINe-GRrained Evaluation of ACTionability in Explainable Automatic Fact-Checking

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the scores assigned by LLM-based evaluators to explanations generated by their own underlying models against human annotations, and classifying cases where the evaluator overestimates the score by at least 2 units on a Likert scale as ego-centric bias.
